name: New-Grad Nurse Buying Your First Home in Temple? What You Can Actually Afford (2026)
description: Hospital nurses usually aren't eligible for the Homes for Texas Heroes down-payment program (that's mostly for school nurses) — but they almost always qualify for the income-based Home Sweet Texas program from TSAHC, which gives 3–5% toward a down payment plus an MCC mortgage tax credit. Taylor Dasch with EG Realty, a Temple market-data analyst, runs the real FHA monthly payment on Temple homes from $200K to $265K, shows how the down payment gets nearly erased, and gives the honest trade-offs. Education and strategy only; not lending, tax, or financial advice — confirm your numbers with a lender. Verified June 2026.
